comment: Bug 7 of the hunt of 2026-10-08: the Add Effect Layer browser previews a whole-picture filter whole. A document of 1920 by 1280 with the photograph of the harness's references imported as a layer, and Layer > Effect Layer opened over it. Kaleidoscope is searched and selected, and the first shot shows the browser's tile, which has to be the whole photograph under its kaleidoscope and not a fragment on the chequer. The browser is closed, an ellipse round the centre is selected and Kaleidoscope picked again: the tile covers the ellipse's bounds, the fold inside the ellipse and the plain photograph outside it, which is what Apply would write. The selection is dropped, Kaleidoscope is added as an effect layer and applied, and the look is the canvas the first tile has to look like. Last the photograph and the effect layer are hidden and a short red stroke is painted on a layer of its own just below the right of the centre, inside the wedge the kaleidoscope repeats at its defaults, six mirrors from 0 degrees: the tile covers the whole canvas the fold writes, so the stroke shows twelve times round the centre, where the painted bounds alone were a small corner of it.
